title: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) predicted effector genes (Stanzick KJ et al., 2021)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Discovery and prioritization of variants and genes for kidney function in >1.2 million individuals.
Stanzick KJ, et al.
Nat Commun. 2021 Jul 16;12(1):4350. doi: 10.1038/s41467-021-24491-0.
PMID: 34272381

After performing a GWAS meta-analysis for creatinine-based estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFRcrea) in 1.2 million subjects from the Chronic Kidney Disease Genetics Consortium (CKDGen) and UK Biobank, the authors prioritized genes at 424 significantly associated loci, considering genes within each locus and 250kb of flanking sequences.

Evidence for prioritization included credible set membership, variant annotations, kidney eQTLs and sQTLs, phenotypes of the orthologous gene in mouse, human monogenic kidney disease genes, eQTL-GWAS signal colocalization, and the DEPICT algorithm.

The prioritization method assigns a score from 0 (least supporting evidence) to 6 (most supporting evidence) to each gene.
